title: I’ve noticed that at least at a certain level the dream content seems to be an almost perfect reflection of my current state of mind and train of thought.
content: Like as long as my focus is on love and positivity the dream keeps getting better and more welcoming but as soon as any negativity enters my mind it is perfectly reflected in the dream. I wonder if some of these “hell realms” that people experience might just be there own mind spiraling down into extremely negative thought loops. On at least one occasion I’ve been down in one of these evil/demonic seeming dimensions but as soon as I recognized what was going on I was able to not feed any more negativity into it and it gradually shifted back into a relatively neutral to positive experience before I was able to wake up. It’s almost like a perfect visual biofeedback experience of everything going on in your mind. This isn’t necessarily the case however for some of the more intense “mallworldy” dreams which seem to have some outside sources of content generation.
